name: Gemcitabine + nab-Paclitaxel (MPACT)
cyclesNote: Continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity; 6 cycles shown as a planning default. Used first-line (moderate performance status), as neoadjuvant when a triplet is not tolerable, and as a gemcitabine-based second line after FOLFIRINOX.

institution.provenance: ONCOTREE grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: The gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel cytotoxic backbone is not biomarker-restricted. Germline BRCA1/2 and PALB2, and tumor MSI/MMR, NTRK, KRAS and HER2 are tested to direct platinum, PARP-inhibitor, immunotherapy or targeted options, not to select this backbone.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: moderate emetic risk; give guideline-tier antiemetic prophylaxis before gemcitabine + nab-paclitaxel.

supportiveCare: Monitor for myelosuppression (neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, anaemia); hold or reduce for cytopenias on a treatment day.
Assess peripheral neuropathy each cycle (nab-paclitaxel); dose-reduce or hold for grade 2 or higher.
No routine steroid/antihistamine premedication is required for nab-paclitaxel (albumin-bound, solvent-free).
monitoring: liver and renal function before each cycle
CA 19-9 and imaging to assess response

doseModificationRules.condition: neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, or grade 2+ neuropathy on a treatment day
doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Hold day 8 or 15 for cytopenias and reduce nab-paclitaxel (and gemcitabine) at the next cycle per protocol; dose-reduce nab-paclitaxel for peripheral neuropathy. Physician decides.

drugs.name: nab-Paclitaxel
drugs.notes: nab-Paclitaxel (albumin-bound) 125 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 8 and 15 of a 28-day cycle, given before gemcitabine. Dose per the MPACT metastatic pancreatic regimen; reduce for neuropathy or cytopenias. Source: standard of care per NCCN Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma / DeVita general reference (own wording).

drugs.name: Gemcitabine
drugs.notes: Gemcitabine 1,000 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 8 and 15 of a 28-day cycle, given after nab-paclitaxel. Hold on a treatment day for cytopenias. Source: standard of care per NCCN Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma / DeVita general reference (own wording).
